metadata.name: tax_amm
metadata.description: A Pipeline strategy whose markets take their tax in one chosen mint

instructions.name: distribute
docs: Custom action: anyone pays out what one tax slot is owed, a tax recipient or the
suite share to its wallet's associated token account for the tax-side mint (created
at the caller's expense when missing), the burn by burning from the vault.
Remaining accounts are the tax-side mint's transfer-hook accounts.

accounts.name: payer
docs: Anyone; pays for the slot wallet's token account when it is missing.

accounts.name: tax_mint
docs: Read-only for a payout, so payouts never write-lock the mint (for wrapped SOL, the one
native mint every SOL transfer reads); writable for the burn, which lowers its supply.

accounts.name: recipient_token_account
docs: and, when missing, created by the handler.

instructions.name: pipeline_init_market
docs: Creates a tax market. `data` is the Borsh-encoded [`InitParams`].

accounts.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA for this market state.

accounts.name: market_state
docs: A fresh keypair the creator generated, which signs (metadata `new_keypair`). The
router passes its signature on only while the account is empty and unfunded.

accounts.name: payer
docs: A router PDA holding the SOL the creator allowed for setup. Rent comes from it; the
router returns what is left to the creator.

instructions.name: pipeline_market_info
docs: Reports the market's mints, vaults and exact-out support.

instructions.name: pipeline_quote
docs: Prices a trade without changing anything.

instructions.name: pipeline_resolve_accounts
docs: Lists the strategy accounts a swap needs, after the router's ten fixed ones: the
output vault and the vault authority.

instructions.name: pipeline_seed_liquidity
docs: Pipeline's optional extension, for a launchpad graduating a token: creates a tax
market at the PDA `["seeded", seeder, mint_0, mint_1]` with the creation parameters
in `request.data` (whose seeder is ignored: the calling program's PDA is the
seeder), takes `request.amounts` from the seeder's escrows and opens it. Returns
`SeedResult`. Remaining accounts are transfer-hook accounts, for either mint.

accounts.name: seeder
docs: A PDA of the calling program, signing; it owns the escrows and becomes the seeder.

accounts.name: payer
docs: A system account holding the SOL the caller allows for rent.

accounts.name: escrow_0
docs: program the rest.

instructions.name: pipeline_swap
docs: Settles a trade the router sends. Remaining accounts: the output vault and the
vault authority, then the output mint's transfer-hook accounts.

accounts.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA; compared with the market state's `market_signer`.

instructions.name: renounce_tax_authority
docs: Custom action: the tax authority renounces, after which the market's taxes and
recipients never change again.

accounts.name: tax_authority
docs: Checked against the market's tax authority by [`TaxAuthorityAction::authorize`], so a
market that has none, or renounced, says so rather than naming the signer.

instructions.name: seed
docs: Custom action: the seeder funds the market once, before any swap, and opens it.
Remaining accounts are transfer-hook accounts, for either mint.

accounts.name: seeder_token_0
docs: the token program the rest.

instructions.name: set_recipients
docs: Custom action: the tax authority replaces the tax recipients, their shares and the
burn share, under the rules of creation. What each slot is owed stays with the slot.

accounts.name: tax_authority
docs: Checked against the market's tax authority by [`TaxAuthorityAction::authorize`], so a
market that has none, or renounced, says so rather than naming the signer.

instructions.name: set_taxes
docs: Custom action: the tax authority moves the buy and sell tax, each inside the range
fixed at creation. The next swap pays the new rates.

accounts.name: tax_authority
docs: Checked against the market's tax authority by [`TaxAuthorityAction::authorize`], so a
market that has none, or renounced, says so rather than naming the signer.

errors.name: BadInitData
errors.msg: Init data is not valid creation parameters

errors.name: NotPipeline
errors.msg: Caller is not this market's Pipeline market

errors.name: WrongAccount
errors.msg: Unexpected account

errors.name: EqualMints
errors.msg: A market's two mints must differ

errors.name: NotAMint
errors.msg: A market's mints must be SPL Token or Token-2022 mints

errors.name: MintExtensionNotAllowed
errors.msg: The mint carries an extension the mint rules refuse

errors.name: WrongTokenProgram
errors.msg: The token program is not the mint's

errors.name: BadTaxSide
errors.msg: The tax side must be 0 or 1

errors.name: BadVirtualSide
errors.msg: The virtual side must be 0 or 1

errors.name: TaxAboveCap
errors.msg: A tax range may not go above MAX_TAX_BPS

errors.name: RangeInverted
errors.msg: A tax range's minimum is above its maximum

errors.name: RateOutsideRange
errors.msg: A tax rate is outside its range

errors.name: NoSeeder
errors.msg: The seeder must not be the default key

errors.name: NoRecipient
errors.msg: A market needs at least one tax recipient

errors.name: RecipientsOutOfOrder
errors.msg: Used recipient slots come first, unused slots after them

errors.name: ZeroShare
errors.msg: A used recipient slot needs a share above 0

errors.name: ShareWithoutRecipient
errors.msg: An unused recipient slot must have no share

errors.name: SharesNotWhole
errors.msg: The recipients' shares and the burn share must sum to 10,000

errors.name: BurnOnNativeSol
errors.msg: Native SOL can't be burned, so its tax side has no burn share

errors.name: MarketNotOpen
errors.msg: The market is not open: it has not been seeded

errors.name: ExactOutNotSupported
errors.msg: Exact-out swaps are not supported

errors.name: Overflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: NotSeeder
errors.msg: Only the market's seeder can seed it

errors.name: AlreadySeeded
errors.msg: The market has already been seeded

errors.name: ZeroSeed
errors.msg: A side without a virtual reserve needs a seed above 0

errors.name: ZeroOutput
errors.msg: The trade's output would be 0

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidity
errors.msg: The trade would pay out more than the market's real reserve

errors.name: NoTaxAuthority
errors.msg: The market has no tax authority, so its taxes and recipients never change

errors.name: AlreadyRenounced
errors.msg: The tax authority renounced, so the market's taxes and recipients never change again

errors.name: NotTaxAuthority
errors.msg: Only the market's tax authority can change its taxes and recipients

errors.name: OwedSlotLeftEmpty
errors.msg: A recipient slot still owed tax can't be emptied; pay it out or name another wallet

errors.name: BadSeedAmounts
errors.msg: A seed request gives one amount for each of the market's two mints

errors.name: NoSuchSlot
errors.msg: No such tax slot: there is one per tax recipient, then the burn's and the suite share's

errors.name: UnusedSlot
errors.msg: The tax recipient slot is unused: it has no wallet to pay

errors.name: NotSlotWallet
errors.msg: The wallet is not the tax slot's

errors.name: NotSlotTokenAccount
errors.msg: The token account is not the slot wallet's associated token account for the tax-side mint

errors.name: BurnNeedsWritableMint
errors.msg: The burn lowers the tax-side mint's supply, so it needs the mint writable

types.name: Distributed
docs: One tax slot was paid out (docs/spec/tax-amm.md, "Payout"): `amount` of the tax-side
mint went to the associated token account of `recipient`, or was burned from the vault
for the burn slot, whose `recipient` is the default key. A slot with nothing owed pays
nothing and emits nothing.

fields.name: slot
docs: 0 to 3 a tax recipient, 4 the burn, 5 the suite share.

types.name: InitParams
docs: `create_market`'s `init_data`: these fields, Borsh-encoded in this order.
`metadata.json`'s `init.args` lists the same fields, with the arrays flattened into
`recipient_0` to `recipient_3` and `share_0` to `share_3`, because metadata arguments
have no arrays; a fixed-size array encodes exactly as its elements one after another,
so both describe the same bytes.

fields.name: tax_side
docs: The mint index (0 or 1) every tax is taken in, fixed for the market's life.

fields.name: tax_authority
docs: May change the rates inside their ranges and the recipients; the default key means
none, so the market's taxes and recipients never change.

fields.name: seeder
docs: The only signer the seed action accepts.

fields.name: recipients
docs: Owner wallets; used slots first, unused slots the default key.

fields.name: shares
docs: Each used slot's share in basis points of the creator's part, above 0; unused 0.

fields.name: burn_share_bps
docs: The burn's share of the creator's part.

fields.name: virtual_side
docs: The mint index (0 or 1) whose reserve the virtual reserve adds to in pricing.

fields.name: virtual_reserve
docs: 0 for none.

types.name: MarketCreated
docs: A tax market was created through the router's `create_market`.

types.name: MarketStatus
docs: Where a market is in its life. New states are only ever added after the last.

types.name: RecipientsChanged
docs: The tax authority changed the market's tax recipients, their shares or the burn share.
What each slot is already owed stays with the slot.

types.name: ResolveRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::ResolveRequest`.

types.name: SeedRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::SeedRequest`: the most to take from each escrow, in mint
order, and the creation parameters, Borsh-encoded as [`crate::InitParams`].

types.name: Seeded
docs: The seeder funded a market, which opened. `amounts` is what arrived in each vault, in
mint order, which the market recorded as its real reserves.

types.name: SwapRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::SwapRequest`.

types.name: TaxAuthorityRenounced
docs: The tax authority renounced: the market's taxes and recipients never change again.

types.name: TaxMarket
docs: A tax market: the market state account the router records and passes to every call.

fields.name: version
docs: [`STATE_VERSION`].

fields.name: tax_side
docs: The mint index (0 or 1) every tax is taken in; fixed at creation.

fields.name: virtual_side
docs: The mint index (0 or 1) whose reserve `virtual_reserve` adds to; fixed at creation.

fields.name: authority_bump
docs: The bump of the vault authority PDA.

fields.name: tax_authority_renounced
docs: Set once the tax authority renounces, after which taxes and recipients never change.

fields.name: mints
docs: The two mints, in the creator's order.

fields.name: vaults
docs: The vault for each mint, in the same order.

fields.name: market_signer
docs: The router's market PDA for this market state, the only caller allowed to swap.

fields.name: tax_authority
docs: The default key when the market has none.

fields.name: reserves
docs: What the market owns in each vault, as far as pricing is concerned.

fields.name: owed
docs: Tax booked to each slot and not yet paid out, in the tax-side mint (see
[`OWED_SLOTS`]).

fields.name: tax_collected
docs: Counters for the containment hook, changed only by router swaps.

fields.name: created_slot
docs: When the market was created.

types.name: TaxesChanged
docs: The tax authority changed the market's rates; the next swap pays them.

types.name: TradeRequest
docs: `pipeline_strategy_interface::TradeRequest`.

constants.name: BURN_SLOT
docs: The burn's slot. Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script and Aviary
read which `distribute` slot burns.

constants.name: MAX_TAX_BPS
docs: The highest buy or sell tax any tax market may ever charge, in basis points: 10%, so no
tax market can be a honeypot through its tax. Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`).

constants.name: SUITE_SHARE_BPS
docs: The suite share, in basis points of every tax, taken before the creator's split: 10%.
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script reads it.

constants.name: SUITE_SLOT
docs: The suite share's slot. Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), like [`BURN_SLOT`].

constants.name: SUITE_TREASURY
docs: The wallet the suite share is paid to. On devnet its key is
`~/.config/testing-pipeline/devnet/suite-treasury.json` (docs/toolchain.md, "Keys").
Published in the IDL (`#[constant]`), where the demo script and Aviary read the suite
share slot's wallet for `distribute`.
